# Smallest Index With Digit Sum Equal to Index.

@example The digit sums are 5, 4, 2, 9 and 8, so only position 2 (1 + 1 = 2) is a match.
[5,40,11,702,8]
=> 2

@example The digit sums are 0, 1 and 2: every position is a match, and the lowest is 0.
[0,100,20]
=> 0

@example Every digit sum is 9, but the positions only go up to 2.
[9,9,9]
=> -1

# A single element: zero matches at position 0, anything else doesn't.
[0]
=> 0

[7]
=> -1

# 1000 has digit sum 1.
[3,1000]
=> 1

# A one-digit value equal to its position is a match too.
[4,1,6]
=> 1

# Several matches (positions 1 to 4): the lowest one is the answer.
[8,10,2,30,13]
=> 1

# Positions count from 0, not 1, and a zero after position 0 never matches.
[1,0,0,0]
=> -1

# The leading digit counts: 902 has digit sum 11, not 2.
[5,5,902,799]
=> -1

# A three-digit match, after ten values with digit sum 25.
[799,799,799,799,799,799,799,799,799,799,901]
=> 10

# 999 (digit sum 27) matches only at position 27.
[999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999]
=> 27

[999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999]
=> -1

# A long array with no match: position 27 holds 998 (digit sum 26), and no
# position past 27 can ever match.
[999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,998,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999,999]
=> -1

# The only match is the last position.
[1,5,12,21]
=> 3

# Random cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
[902,13,871,300,235,191,827]
=> 3

@gen 2 small
[23,1000,26,2,29]
=> 1

@gen 3 small
[27,22,11,5,4,17,18,27,16,19,25,12,17,13,12,29,27,22,20,23,23,1,13,23,9,18]
=> 2

@gen 4 small
[21,13,30]
=> -1

@gen 5 small
[11,100]
=> 1

@gen 6 small
[172,371,852,113,750,532,559,122,449,751,758,341,898,156,374,448,263,126,330,335,328,639,60,109,895,846,998,440,184,439]
=> 14

@gen 7 small
[16,3,27,10,26,30,51]
=> 6

@gen 1
[196,985,297,902,871,121,466,235,191,827,473,409,176,558,15,675,184,877,229,544,68,989,499,347,394,473,546,562,680,807,716,479,664,466,141,587,8,332,771,178,30,726,711,382,84,822,975,938,374,249,376,840,615,112,320,259,595,505,687,854,323,65,72,958,645,306,37,616,635,366,42,469,421,953,60,324,330,488,111,300,786,785,77,47,341,604,562,445,610,56,578,434,289,543,963,552,456,395,14,735]
=> 22

@gen 2
[160,812,120,805,408,810,400,553,115,77,38,338,623,528,802,420,769,241,336,502,65,94,500,269,605,42,453,999,577,501,256,939,909,247,420,827,991,151,243,248,72,251,370,699,619,997,675,769,231,232,680,600,462,7,874,432,484,566,459,759,906,264,490,276,970,496,385,567,478,854,542,563,562,239,999,707,900,376,276,309,875,785,105,747,970,357,852,696,464,175,547,821,948,663,586,995,540,544,976,579]
=> 27

@gen 5
[496,736,712,551,157,266,242,462,576,591,812,568,946,534,301,170,577,848,2,360,968,290,204,387,833,323,228,229,488,246,495,944,419,516,466,904,932,808,289,826,655,204,542,949,708,277,165,603,918,320,824,149,45,61,458,578,138,38,241,341,488,772,846,754,872,311,235,512,832,605,147,410,334,844,881,176,64,619,349,60,236,237,224,227,804,835,302,655,1,730,477,831,466,489,380,80,586,349,750,735]
=> -1
